experiment: Application1 sensor-layout comparison: 2 source configs x 3 layouts

cases.layout_description: boundary-only: 25 outer-boundary nodes (right 13, bottom 6, top 6), the existing node_sensors_right_bottom_top_c06 set
mixed: 10 outer-boundary nodes (right 6, bottom 2, top 2) + 15 interior fluid nodes around buildings / in streets and wakes
deliberately weak: 25 interior fluid nodes upstream of the sources or screened by buildings / poorly connected to their downstream paths (intended to provide weak observations)

physical_settings.source model: f = sum_i A_i exp(-|x-c_i|^2 / sigma2)  (repo convention: sigma2 == rho)
physical_settings.observation: discrete node sensors, 25 per layout, equal weights W = I (w = 1.0)
physical_settings.noise: none (noiseless synthetic data, generated per layout by the same forward model)
physical_settings.center bounds: mesh bounding box + fluid-mesh admissibility (raw feasibility mode)
physical_settings.dirichlet: homogeneous Dirichlet on 'left' (inflow) nodes only; no sensor there
physical_settings.initialization: adjoint sensitivity beam (predicted_reduction, top-K 24, beam 3) + refinement, OSQP joint amplitude fit
physical_settings.local optimizer: L-BFGS-B, max-iter 150, ftol 1e-14, gtol 1e-9, maxls 20 (driver constants)
physical_settings.random seed: 0 (recorded; not consumed by the sensitivity path per docs)
physical_settings.measurement-boundaries: not passed (only labels/plot context in nodes+equal mode)

git.note: experiment scripts are untracked new files; copies in scripts/

environment.thread_policy: threads unset -> BLAS/OpenMP use all cores; cases run sequentially

launch.mechanism: setsid nohup, stdin </dev/null, output to files (no batch scheduler on host)
